_meta.description: Disc Drive main-stat / substat expected-value tables and roll-budget rules, for disc_rules.py's validator/repair (see docs/DESIGN_disc_validation.md 'Expected-value tables'). Rarity keys are ZodDisc.rarity ints: 4=S, 3=A, 2=B. Main/substat keys are the ZOD keys from stats.json (main_stats_by_slot / substats) — reconciled key-for-key, not retyped independently. Cross-verified against the June 22 archive: A-rank hp/atk substat bases (75/13) contradict stats.json's stale substat_step_values block (79/15, unused dead data sourced from AdeptiScanner 2026-06-02) — archive samples (75.0, 13.0, 26.0=13*2) confirm the wiki values here, not stats.json's.
_meta.b_rank_growth_note: B-rank main-stat growth is unverified on the wiki (only 1 B-rank disc observed in the archive); assumed 1/3 per level so max multiplier is 4.0x at max level 9, matching S and A.
_meta.wind_dmg_note: Added 2026-07-04 (T8): 'Wind DMG Bonus' is a legitimate 6th element main stat (slot 5), same base/growth as the other 5 element DMG bonuses. Confirmed by archive evidence (Wuthering Salon slot-5 discs, formula-exact at levels 6/12) and by user; not a scanner bug.
